ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white/yellowish) pixels localized primarily at the distal tips and scattered in a mottled pattern.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white/yellow) contiguous clusters at the extreme left and right tips; a significant white mottled patch on the upper-middle region of the left lobe; sporadic low-density white pixel speckling across the central dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 75 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the majority of the trailing edge; a notable series of deeper indentations (valleys) on the inner-left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature on the distal edges leading to pointed, upward-tilted lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast yellowish-white clusters localized at the left and right distal tips, creating a highly textured/jagged appearance.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular notch/indentation on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe that disrupts the regular serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme concentration of high-intensity calcified-looking material at the distal tips creates a unique 'capped' visual effect.
